name: Kohinoor Samudra Beach Resort
why_special: Kohinoor Group's beach resort 11 km south of Ratnagiri town on Ganeshgule beach — 70 cottage-style rooms across landscaped grounds, outdoor pool, multi-cuisine Konkani restaurant. The polished beach-resort default for Ratnagiri.

name: Hotel Landmark Ratnagiri
why_special: Senior Ratnagiri town 3-star at Maruti Mandir junction — multi-cuisine restaurant, the reliable mid-range pick for travellers using Ratnagiri as a Konkan-route overnight rather than a beach stay.

name: Pawas Swaroopanand Ashram Bhakta Niwas
why_special: The Swami Swaroopanand Pawas ashram's pilgrim accommodation 19 km south of Ratnagiri — simple twin and family rooms attached to the samadhi mandir, satvic meals included. Booking through ashram directly; the spiritual alternative to beach resorts.
